title: No Travel Incomplete | APPR | Controllable | Cash
description:
Two-leg domestic journey where Leg 2 is cancelled. Customer is stranded at midpoint (YYZ) � they neither reached their destination (YVR) nor returned to origin (YUL). Validates DDS correctly identifies No Travel Incomplete status, which is the most complex No Travel scenario since customer is at neither endpoint.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (�mile Gagnon), 2 segments AC domestic YUL?YYZ?YVR within one bound. Seg 1 (AC 450, YUL?YYZ): Operated, on time. Seg 2 (AC 451, YYZ?YVR): CANCELLED. Cancellation code: EQUI(Equipment issue). Customer action: Stayed at YYZ (midpoint). Did NOT return to YUL. Did NOT reach YVR. No Travel status: Incomplete.
